summary: Frontend-only test for sessions/coaches migration. PREREQUISITE SQL MIGRATION HAS NOT BEEN RUN — /rest/v1/sessions and /rest/v1/team_coaches return 404 (relation does not exist). This blocks all end-to-end tests for cross-client visibility, coach create/delete, and multi-team scheduling. All client-side UI changes verified individually: (a) modal no longer has Session Title free-text input, (b) modal is fixed inset-0 viewport-anchored with backdrop-blur and does not scroll, (c) Cancel/Create buttons fully visible at 1920x800, (d) Team dropdown [data-testid=session-team-select] correctly lists ALL 5 teams across every age group (JOELS Dublin Lions, Abbey Seals Dublin Lions, Dublin Lions U14 Boys, Dublin Lions U14 Girls, Academy U10), (e) Type dropdown present, (f) Coach Assignment Section renders in the roster modal with data-testid='coach-assignment-section', 'coach-email-input', 'coach-add-btn'. rca of the issue: Root cause: The Supabase migration /app/app/supabase/sessions-setup.sql defining public.sessions and public.team_coaches (plus RLS + realtime publication) has not been executed on the Supabase project neulcrpkroiyglgiywcp. Symptom: All fetches issued by pullSessionsFromRemote / getTeamCoachesFromCache return HTTP 404 with 42P01 semantics (relation does not exist), preventing per-row realtime sync, coach permission checks, and cross-client visibility. Reproduction: Open DevTools Network tab on either dashboard → filter 'sessions' or 'team_coaches' → observe 404. Mitigation: Execute the SQL file in the Supabase SQL editor as instructed in the request. No frontend code change needed.
